testing_mode: GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
DD1: fallthrough site inventory document exists; frozen before bash blocks written

## What
Analyze all 11 target skill files to identify every graceful-degradation prose fallthrough decision point. Produce plugins/dso/docs/fallthrough-site-inventory.md with the exact location of each fallthrough site and the frozen EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark format for all cluster tasks.

## EMIT-PRECONDITIONS Format (frozen in this task)
<!-- EMIT-PRECONDITIONS: gate_name=<name> degradation_type=<type> -->
followed by bash block: bash PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/preconditions-record.sh --ticket-id ... --gate-name <name> --degradation --degradation-type <type> --data '{}' 2>/dev/null || true

degradation_type values: inferred_decision | unresolved_question (per e959-9703 DD1)

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/docs/fallthrough-site-inventory.md: table with columns File/LineRange/TriggerPhrase/gate_name/degradation_type/Cluster; FROZEN marker with timestamp

## TDD Exemption
Static doc artifact with no conditional logic — criterion 3 (static assets only / non-executable instruction files per Rule 5).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] plugins/dso/docs/fallthrough-site-inventory.md exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/fallthrough-site-inventory.md
- [ ] Inventory has entries for all 11 target skill files (minimum 11 table rows)
  Verify: awk '/^\| plugins/' plugins/dso/docs/fallthrough-site-inventory.md | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 < 11)}'
- [ ] Inventory contains required columns (gate_name, degradation_type, Cluster)
  Verify: grep -q 'gate_name.*degradation_type.*Cluster' plugins/dso/docs/fallthrough-site-inventory.md
- [ ] FROZEN marker present
  Verify: grep -q 'FROZEN' plugins/dso/docs/fallthrough-site-inventory.md
- [ ] EMIT-PRECONDITIONS format documented in inventory
  Verify: grep -q 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/docs/fallthrough-site-inventory.md
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
